problem:
Let $S=UV.$ What is the value of ${s}_{13}$, if

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}],\,V=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{aligned}]?
$$
worked_solution:
Multiplying the $1$st row in $U$ by the $3$rd column in $V$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{s}_{13} & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2 \\ -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =(-2)\cdot 3+3\cdot (-2)+(-1)\cdot (-5) \\  & =-6-6+5 \\  & =-7.\end{aligned}
$$
